idea-plugin.name: Erbsland Configuration Language (ELCL)
idea-plugin.description:
Language support for the Erbsland Configuration Language.

Provides syntax highlighting, parsing, diagnostics, ELCL-VR authoring support, folding, structure view, commenting, and completion for .elcl files.

Language reference · Source code · Issue tracker
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 0.4.1

  • Fix the changelog displayed in the IDE's plugin update details.
  • Add a semantic, source-ordered Structure view with indexed section-list entries and live updates while editing.
  • Correct multiline parsing, comments, indentation highlighting, and tagged code-language injection.
  • Group color settings and add colors for section syntax, escapes, tags, and ignored multiline whitespace.
  • Improve byte-data and text-escape parsing with precise diagnostics for invalid formats, splits, characters, and Unicode code points.
  • Expand the color preview and reorganize the implementation into focused, documented components.
